description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans reminders functionality using Azure Cosmos DB as the backing store. It defines the 'ReminderTests_Cosmos' class with multiple test cases (e.g., basic reminder operations, multi-grain, multi-reminder, failure scenarios), configuration classes for setting up the test environment, and test methods marked with testing attributes.
